query: Why are different Contribute As You Earn (CAYE) contribution rates applied to different service fees?
reference_answer: Contribute As You Earn (CAYE) contribution rates may change when you (i) update your CAYE contribution rate or (ii) are no longer required to make CAYE contributions. Generally, the updated CAYE contribution rate will apply to service fees paid from the next day.

answer: Different CAYE contribution rates are applied because they adjust based on when your CAYE contribution rate changes or when you're no longer required to make them. Additionally, these rates apply to service fees starting from the next day after updating. The rates can vary based on whether you're using excess contributions to offset MediSave payable or earning interest on MediSave Account. [Document 1]
